source_or_gap: User-authorized incorporation of the complete fifteen-paper additional-source shortlist into twelve existing technical owners and ten reader units, after selected primary-passage and chapter-boundary review.
chapter_action_policy: User-authorized integration of all fifteen screened sources into twelve existing owners, with bounded reader explanations and unchanged core support.
merge_or_split_policy: No new chapter recommended. Neural residual topology belongs to substrate design, not multi-agent learning topology; distinguish learned lookup from external memory.
boundary_decision_rationale: Each proposed source contributes a concrete missing mechanism, comparator, scoped failure mode or contrary result; recency and leaderboard position alone do not determine inclusion.
proof_or_test_backlog: No model execution, scientific replay, training, Docker or Lean campaign is commissioned by this literature search.
evidence_transition_precondition: Preserve source-reported status and exact study scope when adding prose; a citation or review decision cannot promote architecture support.
required_before_drafting: The fifteen standard notes, inventory records and owner-specific mappings were written from the selected primary versions before treating the sources as incorporated.
Current owner mechanisms, adjacent responsibilities and source-specific counterevidence were reviewed.
Any future expansion beyond the recorded selected passages needs further primary review before stronger wording.
promotion_blockers: No local replication, independent formal verification, complete source/code review or general architecture advantage.
residuals: The sweep is selective. It covers 2026 work and missing late-2025/early-2026 foundations rather than only October announcements.
RP1 and multi-agent reward-hacking current revisions supersede the initially retrieved versions; Attention Residuals required PDF text because its HTML conversion lacks the paper.
next_action: Maintain the fifteen registered versions, source notes and twelve explanatory owner routes. Review new versions or expanded claim scopes through the same selected-passage and evidence-boundary process.
non_claims: No new chapter, stronger core support, proof definition, scientific outcome, private-source publication or broader-goal completion.
Paper results remain external source reports at their recorded scope, without independent reproduction.
